purpose: Separate formal relational reasoning, professional belief calibration, evidence-sensitive reframing, clinical cognitive restructuring and cognitive reappraisal within the IQ Mindware explicit Reasoning architecture.
governing_rule: Cognitive restructuring is an applied explicit-reasoning intervention family, not merely a SMART-style wrapper and not a generic reasoning-capacity score.

core_operations: distinguish valid, invalid and cannot-tell outcomes
recover structure across symbolic, nonsense-semantic and domain-semantic wrappers
records.public_claim: The formal Reasoning route is designed to practise recovery and use of relational structure across symbolic and verbal forms.
records.caveat: SMART and adjacent instructional evidence provide an emerging rationale, but the exact IQ Mindware protocol and broad transfer remain unvalidated.

records.public_claim: A professional Reasoning route may train explicit separation of validity, believability, evidence strength and confidence.
records.caveat: The route is evidence-informed and suitable for pilot evaluation; it is not proven to improve consequential professional judgement.

core_operations: select a small safe discriminating test
records.public_claim: Evidence-Sensitive Reframing may practise generating, comparing and testing alternative appraisals in low-risk work, study or performance scenarios.
records.caveat: This is non-clinical cognitive skills practice, not psychotherapy, diagnosis or treatment.

core_operations: select a test that discriminates among models
make local rather than indiscriminate global revision
records.public_claim: A behavioural-probe component may test whether an appraisal predicts what actually happens and support proportionate model revision.
records.caveat: A probe must be safe, genuinely discriminating and appropriate to the use context; clinical behavioural experiments require governed protocols.

records.public_claim: A condition-specific partner protocol may investigate explicit cognitive restructuring as part of evidence-based depression support.
records.caveat: Clinical category evidence does not validate the generic IQ Mindware Reasoning app; professional oversight, safety governance and direct protocol evaluation are required.

records.public_claim: A partner-led GAD protocol may include cognitive restructuring within a broader evidence-based CBT pathway.
records.caveat: Evidence is stronger for full CBT than isolated cognitive restructuring; no self-service IQ Mindware treatment claim is eligible.

records.public_claim: A governed CBT-I pathway may use cognitive restructuring to address sleep-related appraisals as one protocol component.
records.caveat: Component evidence is condition-specific and does not validate the generic Reasoning Coach or establish a stand-alone digital treatment.

records.public_claim: A separately specified reappraisal route may practise reinterpretation of emotional meaning in a bounded non-clinical or governed context.
records.caveat: Reappraisal is related to but not identical with cognitive restructuring, and executive-function involvement does not validate a generic Reasoning app as reappraisal training.

records.public_claim: LLM systems may support research on structured Socratic and cognitive-restructuring dialogue under explicit human review.
records.caveat: Prepublication dialogue and synthetic-data results do not establish therapeutic efficacy, safety or equivalence to a qualified clinician.
